title.narrative: Strengthening the Capacity of the National Council for Family Affairs

description.narrative: The following are the key tasks that the National Council will carry out (as decribed in the IDF proposal): (a) To consolidate/ finalize its strategic direction and action plan and disseminate these to governmental organizations, NGOs, decision-makers etc., a national conference will be held at the end of the first year. Audio-visual equipment (including data show) will be procured in support of this activity. (b) To help enhance the skills of the secretariat staff, training will be provided in the following areas: team building and team work, advocacy, efficient administration and financial management, fund raising and communication skills, each by a qualified trainer for about 1 week each. Computers/ printers (2) and relevant software will be procured in support of this activity. (c) To help develop the coordination mechanisms, web site and networking options, qualified consultants (2) will be hired for a period of 4 months. These consultants will work alongside the relevant Council members and secretariat staff to help build the capacity in coordination systems and in web maintenance and ongoing networking tasks. One computer and printer will be procured in support of this activity. To support all of the above activities, a heavy-duty photocopier machine will be procured. Equipment request in the proposal (20% of the grant) falls well within IDF guidelines and they are for supporting specific activities. No vehicles or furniture will be procured.
